patient_selection_framework.name: Two-Gate Patient Selection System
patient_selection_framework.description: A two-gate validation system applied to published biomarker subgroup data from MSS CRC IO trials. Gate 1 scores patient biology alignment with drug mechanism. Gate 2 validates that the mechanism signal has not been invalidated in a Phase III trial.

slides.title: The CARMEN-LC03 Lesson
slides.subtitle: CrisPRO decoded what went wrong — and can prevent it from happening in the CRC cohort.

timeline_events.event: SAR445953 CRC cohort — Same IHC gate risk

slides.decode_box: CARMEN-LC03 enrolled CEACAM5 ≥2+/≥50% — this includes IO-suppressed patients who cannot mount an immune response to ADC-mediated cell killing. The ≥80% post-hoc signal reflects higher antigen density → better ADC internalization. The missing gate: IO permissiveness. The correct patient: CEACAM5 ≥80% + pTMB ≥28 OR Immunoscore-IC-high.
